After a conflict ends (both audio and video remain calm beyond a preset window, default 10 minutes) and no new conflict occurs, the system automatically outputs an aftercare prompt: playing soft music via a smart speaker or pushing caring messages through a mobile APP (such as 'Need a cup of tea?', 'Take a deep breath, speak slowly'). This skill aims to help family members soothe their emotions after intense arguments and restore communication. Application scenarios: family living rooms, kitchens, dining rooms and other conflict-prone areas. The system provides non-intrusive emotional comfort after conflicts. Skill features: family emotions easily continue to deteriorate after a conflict; appropriate external cues (music, caring words) can break the negative loop and encourage calm communication. AI-based automatic conflict detection with timely soothing helps maintain family harmony, especially for families with teenagers or members prone to emotional escalation. Can be integrated into smart speakers or home-security systems as a distinctive family-care feature. | 通过家庭客厅或厨房的固定摄像头（含麦克风），实时监测家庭成员间的冲突事件，识别高分贝争吵（声音强度超过阈值且持续时间>10秒）、摔门（物体撞击声+门框振动）、甩手等激烈肢体动作。当冲突事件结束后（音频和视频均平静超过预设时间，默认10分钟）且无新冲突，系统自动输出缓和提示：通过智能音箱播放轻柔音乐，或通过手机APP推送关怀语（如'需要一杯茶吗？'、'深呼吸，慢慢说'）。该技能旨在帮助家庭成员在激烈争执后平复情绪，促进沟通恢复。应用场景：家庭客厅、厨房、餐厅等易发生冲突的区域。系统在冲突后提供非介入式情绪安抚。技能特点：家庭冲突后情绪易持续恶化，适当的外界提示（如音乐、关怀语）可打断负面情绪循环，促进冷静沟通。通过AI自动识别冲突并适时提供安抚，有助于维护家庭和谐，尤其适合有青少年或情绪易失控成员的家庭。该技能可集成到智能音箱或家庭安防系统中，成为家庭关怀的特色功能。
skills.name: Family Conflict Aftercare Suggestion | 夫妻/家人冲突后情绪缓和提示

skills.description:
🧠 AI 写代码最大的敌人，是它自己——今天修好的 Bug，明天照样犯。
Vibe Coding Rules V2.5 是给 AI 装上的"编程纪律外骨骼"：6 个自我进化的 Skill 组成一条完整流水线——改前五大原则自查 → 终端安全执行 → 改后 28 条规则逐项扫描 → Playwright 自动化回归测试 → 变更日志自动归档。每一步自动触发，一条龙闭环。
🍞 面包屑系统（独家）：每次改代码，文件头部自动播下导航标记——耦合文件在哪、历史坑位在哪、设计文档在哪——下次 AI 打开同一个文件，秒懂上下文，不再失忆。
📈 规则自生长：同一个 Bug 犯了 3 次？自动升级为硬规则，AI 永远不能再犯。越用越聪明，越用越安全。
🔌 即装即用：下载→解压→装到你的 AI Agent。支持 CodeBuddy / Cursor / Windsurf。开源 Apache 2.0，免费商用。
🧠 Your AI's worst enemy is itself—it forgets the bugs it fixed yesterday.

Vibe Coding Rules V2.5 is a discipline exoskeleton for your AI coding agent. 6 self-evolving Skills in one pipeline: Pre-code 5-principle check → Safe terminal execution → Post-code 28-rule scan → Playwright automated regression testing → Changelog auto-archive. Every step triggers automatically, closed loop, zero manual effort.
🍞 Breadcrumb System (exclusive) : Every code change auto-plants navigation markers in file headers—coupled files, historical gotchas, design doc links. Next time AI opens the same file, it instantly knows the context. Say goodbye to AI amnesia.
📈 Self-Growing Rules: Same bug appears 3 times? Auto-promoted to a hard rule the AI can never violate again. The more you code, the smarter—and safer—it gets.
🔌 Plug & Play: Download → Unzip → Install to your AI agent. Works with CodeBuddy / Cursor / Windsurf. Open source Apache 2.0. Free for commercial use.
